status: implemented and locally verified; protected integration, CI and owner acceptance pending
acceptedPriorScope: The owner accepted C-71 on Mark Test C71 f17b070e before reporting this separate footer defect. Acceptance is recorded in 35f99e19 and docs/release-trains/2.5.x-next.md#c-71.

reproduction.ownerReport: Long-cell table in Fit to page mode: an excessive gap precedes the scrollbar, with the column counter outside and below the scroll block.
reproduction.cause: The table's block-end margin, 16px wrapper padding and external caption add separate spaces. Caption visibility previously removed its box on fitting tables.
reproduction.baseline: Four new Chromium/WebKit cases failed before repair: caption outside the wrapper and a visible Full width fitting-table counter.
reproduction.interactionGuard: A new selected-column bottom-handle hit test failed in both engines after moving the caption; a scoped z-index restores handle paint and input above the informational sticky line.

implementation: Table then noneditable caption share one scroll wrapper. Reset table block margins; reserve a 20px counter line, 2px gap and 6px scrollbar zone. Compensate actual consumed native scrollbar height so overlaid/classic/no bars retain the same footer height. Empty fitting-table captions, including Full width, remain invisible without collapsing. Sticky inline placement keeps the counter inside the scrollport; selected-column drag handles remain reachable. Existing Full width editor scroll ownership and persisted widths are retained.

finalScenarios: 28px footer with hidden or visible caption
constant counter position on horizontal scroll
verification.webkitPerformanceGate: passed after the final drag-layer rule; thresholds unchanged
verification.graceCurrent: zero integrity errors; existing baseline/overlap warnings remain

release: Separate follow-up admission required; no version, tag or publication authorized.
